summary: Tested Light/Dark/System appearance onboarding on web (FeatureOnboarding modal) and mobile (InterestOnboarding sheet). Backend GET/PUT /api/shell/prefs round-trips light|dark|system correctly and syncs across sessions (same user). On both surfaces: 'Match device' is pre-highlighted; tapping Dark/Light/System applies the theme live AND persists via PUT /api/shell/prefs; reload keeps the chosen theme; Skip (mobile) and Build-my-Home (web) close the modal. Cross-surface sync verified via API. All 7 backend tests pass. No critical issues found.

issues: ThemeToggle with data-testid='theme-toggle' was NOT found on the Home top bar for a freshly-registered user in the new_look_v2 design. The header shows a 'Dark' label chip (visible top-right) that may or may not be the same toggle — if it is, it's missing the data-testid='theme-toggle' attribute referenced in the spec. Not blocking (the appearance onboarding + /api/shell/prefs path works), but main agent should confirm the theme-toggle is mounted and carries data-testid='theme-toggle' in the AppShellV2 top bar / Me→Settings surface.

parity_issues.issue: Behavior is consistent across surfaces (system pre-highlighted, live preview on tap, persisted to /api/shell/prefs). Minor copy difference: web eyebrow is 'CHOOSE YOUR LOOK' inside the FeatureOnboarding modal (after interests), while mobile 'CHOOSE YOUR LOOK' is a section inside the single InterestOnboarding sheet. This is expected per spec (web splits into two modals, mobile combines into one sheet), not a bug — just noting for parity awareness.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Confirm the ThemeToggle component with data-testid='theme-toggle' is still being rendered somewhere in AppShellV2 / Me→Settings surface for a logged-in user — testing agent could not locate it on the Home page top bar during this run, though the appearance onboarding + /api/shell/prefs flow works end-to-end without it.
critical_code_review_comments: FeatureOnboarding.jsx: appr state (local useState('system')) does not hydrate from the server theme — a user who already saved e.g. 'dark' via mobile would still see 'Match device' pre-highlighted in the web FeatureOnboarding modal rather than their saved choice. Low impact because this modal only shows ONCE for brand-new users (needs_onboarding=true), so there is unlikely to be a prior saved theme. Still, a one-liner `useEffect(() => setAppr(useThemeStore.getState().mode), [])` would make it consistent.
InterestOnboarding.tsx line 33: same issue — appr defaults to 'system' and does not reflect mode from ThemeProvider. Same low-impact rationale.
FeatureOnboarding.jsx line 86: Build button text uses `count` which excludes the appearance choice. Fine — appearance is not a feature. Just confirming intent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all documented flows verified on web + mobile

test_credentials: Registered brand-new users via POST /api/auth/register for both web and mobile runs (needs_onboarding=true). Backend tests used demo@bigfm.dubai / DemoPass123! (session cookie).
seed_data_creation: None — test users were ad-hoc and only touched /api/shell/prefs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Appearance onboarding (Phase: Light/Dark/System first-run) is passing on both surfaces. Backend endpoint /api/shell/prefs round-trips light|dark|system reliably with cross-session sync. The web FeatureOnboarding modal is sequenced AFTER the interests modal via the 'bigfm:interests:done' event — if you only wait for feature-onboarding on a fresh user you must first click or skip the interests sheet. Mobile combines both in a single InterestOnboarding sheet so no sequencing needed. For UI tests on the Expo web preview, log in via POST /api/auth/login and store the returned session_token in localStorage key 'bigfm_session_token' before navigating.
